title: linum perenne var. pyrenaicum
intro: Linum perenne var. pyrenaicum, commonly known as Pyrenean flax, is a variety of the perennial flax plant native to the Pyrenees Mountains. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat a range of health issues. The therapeutic actions of Linum perenne var. pyrenaicum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which can help to soothe skin conditions, wounds, and digestive issues. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, contribute to its therapeutic benefits.
